summary: IB Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a September 15, 2026 Equity Purchase Facility Agreement with an institutional ELOC investor, tied to its pending business combination with GNQ Insilico. The company may sell up to $50.0 million of newly issued Class A common shares, listed as GNQI post-closing, at VWAP-based pricing over a 36-month period after an initial resale registration is effective. Terms include a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap (increaseable to 9.99%) and a 19.99% exchange cap absent stockholder approval, plus a $675,000 convertible commitment note. Watch dilution and deal-closing risk.
